The organizational boundary is three manufacturing campuses. The operational emissions boundary is Scope 1 process gas/fuel; Scope 2 purchased electricity; selected Scope 3 raw materials.
The company applies the same reporting boundary across the annual structured table and the narrative report.
The area, night-light, vegetation and surface-temperature values below are facility-level proxy indicators for the stated AOI and image date.

The stated target is: operational carbon neutrality target by 2035; residual emissions may be offset after reduction. The stated target boundary is Scope 1+2 operational boundary. This is a forward-looking target, not a claim that the company was carbon neutral during 2022-2025.
Estimated photovoltaic capacity is calibrated to annual generation using 1,200 full-load hours. This is an engineering estimate rather than a value derived from a site survey or asset register.
Against continued output growth, the 2025 emissions intensity was reported at 0.1448 tCO2e per production unit, which management linked to process and electricity-management measures.
